# Inline

> Inline is a work chat app for teams and agents. It exposes a Bot HTTP API, a Realtime WebSocket API and SDK, a hosted MCP server, and a CLI for automating chats, messages, spaces, and workflows.

Primary hosts:
- User and docs site: https://inline.chat
- HTTP API: https://api.inline.chat
- MCP server: https://mcp.inline.chat/mcp
- Realtime API: wss://api.inline.chat/realtime

Authentication:
- The Bot HTTP API and CLI use bearer tokens.
- The hosted MCP server uses OAuth 2.1 with PKCE through https://api.inline.chat/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server.

## Agent Surfaces

- [Integration declaration](https://inline.chat/.well-known/integrations.json): Machine-readable surface metadata for Inline's Bot HTTP API, MCP server, CLI, and shared credentials.
- [OpenAPI spec](https://inline.chat/openapi.json): Canonical Bot HTTP API OpenAPI 3.0 JSON.
- [MCP server card](https://inline.chat/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json): Hosted MCP connection endpoint and OAuth metadata.

## Source And Packages

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/inline-chat/inline): Public builder repository for Inline protocol, CLI, SDKs, MCP server, OpenClaw plugin, Hermes adapter, and package source.
- [TypeScript Realtime SDK source](https://github.com/inline-chat/inline/tree/main/packages/sdk): `@inline-chat/realtime-sdk`; realtime transport, protocol client, state helpers, IDs, and tests.
- [Protocol Buffers API schema](https://github.com/inline-chat/inline/tree/main/proto): Public `.proto` contract used by the realtime API and generated clients.
- [TypeScript protocol package](https://github.com/inline-chat/inline/tree/main/packages/protocol): `@inline-chat/protocol`; generated TypeScript package for the public protobuf schema.
- [CLI source](https://github.com/inline-chat/inline/tree/main/cli): Rust source for the `inline` CLI, including auth, chat/message commands, realtime commands, and bundled protobuf schema output.
- [OpenClaw plugin source](https://github.com/inline-chat/inline/tree/main/packages/openclaw): `@inline-openclaw/inline`; OpenClaw channel plugin for using OpenClaw from Inline DMs and chats with an Inline bot token.
- [Hermes Agent adapter source](https://github.com/inline-chat/inline/tree/main/packages/hermes-agent): `@inline-chat/hermes-agent-adapter`; Hermes external platform plugin and Inline realtime sidecar.

## Documentation

- [Bot API](https://inline.chat/docs/bot-api): HTTP API for bots and automations.
- [Realtime API](https://inline.chat/docs/realtime-api): WebSocket API and SDK guidance.
- [MCP server](https://inline.chat/docs/mcp): Connect agents to Inline over MCP.
- [CLI](https://inline.chat/docs/cli): Install and use the Inline command line tool.
- [Creating a bot](https://inline.chat/docs/creating-a-bot): Create or reveal a bot token.
- [OpenClaw setup](https://inline.chat/docs/openclaw): Configure the official Inline OpenClaw plugin.
- [Hermes Agent adapter](https://github.com/inline-chat/inline/blob/main/docs/hermes.md): Install and configure the Inline Hermes Agent adapter.
